verdict.rationale: Relay supports rule-based automation for money movement — auto-transferring deposits across accounts, percentage/dollar-based automated transfers, and multi-step approval rules — which satisfies a narrow slice of 'define rules that trigger actions on events.' However, these are fixed banking-specific triggers (deposits, thresholds, approvals) rather than a general-purpose, AI-native event/action framework (no webhooks, API-triggered rules, or custom event definitions are evidenced). Missing for 10: evidence of programmable/custom event triggers via API or webhooks, broader condition-action rule builder beyond transfers/approvals, and any AI-agent-facing automation interface.
